name: Al-Sahra Petroleum
description: Fueling your ambition, on and off the track.
story: Al-Sahra Petroleum is a leading Saudi Arabian oil and gas company with a commitment to innovation and performance. Recognizing the synergy between motorsport's pursuit of excellence and their own drive for advancement, they invest in racing to showcase their products' reliability and technological prowess. They are keen to partner with teams that demonstrate dedication and a commitment to pushing boundaries.
